main.description: Stream the record writes and space deletions this host holds, across every space the caller may read, as one sequence. Modeled on Jetstream's network.bsky.jetstream.subscribeEvents and framed the same way (xrpc.v1.json): each text frame is a message whose payload $type is network.habitat.space.subscribe#<kind>, or a terminal error frame. Events are replayed from cursor and then followed live. The log is compacted: each record appears once, at the seq of its latest write, so a replay converges on current state but skips intermediate versions. Delivery is at-least-once; consumers apply events idempotently, keyed by uri. Callable with OAuth or service auth (every space the caller holds the reader role on, rechecked as events are delivered) or with a space credential (that one space only). An OAuth token is further limited to the spaces its space: scopes grant read on: read covers every record in a space, read_self only the caller's own, and a token without a covering grant receives nothing from that space. An app subscribing with its org's session therefore receives every space the org can read that its scopes cover, as one sequence. The stream closes with an ExpiredToken error when the presented credential expires; reconnect with a fresh one and the last seq. The spaces, dids, and collections filters are ANDed; each matches all when omitted. Only records stored on this host are streamed: repos synced in from other PDSes through notifyWrite are not.

cursor.description: Resume position, inclusive: events with seq >= cursor are replayed, then the live tail follows. 0 replays from the start. A cursor beyond the next seq to be assigned starts at the live tip after an #info FutureCursor frame. Omitted: start at the live tip.

spaces.description: Spaces to receive events for. Omitted: every space the caller may read. Spaces the caller may not read are ignored rather than rejected, so as not to reveal whether they exist. #spaceDeleted events are only sent for spaces listed here, the space a space credential is for, or spaces the caller owns.

dids.description: Record authors to receive #commit events for. Omitted: every author.

collections.description: Collection NSIDs or '<prefix>.*' patterns to receive #commit events for. Omitted: every collection.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: Rejected before upgrade with HTTP 400: a malformed parameter, or a spaces filter that excludes the one space a space credential can read.

errors.name: ExpiredToken
errors.description: Sent as a stream error frame, then the connection closes: the credential the stream was opened with has expired.

commit.description: A record's latest write: a create, update, or delete.

seq.description: This host's monotonic event sequence number; the stream cursor. Seqs increase but are not contiguous.

space.description: The space the record belongs to. The same author, collection, and rkey can exist in several spaces.

did.description: The record's author: the account whose space repo holds it.

time.description: When the write was stored, microsecond precision.

rev.description: The repo revision of the write; the record's oplog rev in listRepoOps.

record.description: The record's value. Absent for deletes.

cid.description: CID of the record. Absent for deletes.

spaceDeleted.description: A space was deleted. Consumers drop every record and derived state they hold for it.

time.description: When the space was deleted, microsecond precision.

info.description: An advisory, non-fatal notice about the stream. Carries no seq and does not advance the cursor. FutureCursor: the requested cursor was beyond the next seq to be assigned, so the stream started at the live tip.
